entities.summary: "You Don't Know Me" is a song by English DJ and record producer Jax Jones featuring vocals from singer Raye. The song, sampling the bassline of M.A.N.D.Y. vs. Booka Shade's 2005 hit "Body Language", was released as a digital download in the United Kingdom on 9 December 2016, through Polydor Records in the United Kingdom. The song peaked at number three on the UK Singles Chart.
